policy: The soil moisture report must be checked before opening the greenhouse vents. The member newsletter summarises the soil moisture report each month. Mist the seedlings in the morning.

tools.name: tool_b24
tools.description: Reads the soil moisture report for the greenhouse and returns whether the moisture level is within the growing target. Does not modify records.

tools.name: tool_h92
tools.description: Actuates the greenhouse vents to open and records the ventilation event.

tools.name: tool_t23
tools.description: Runs the misting line over the seedling benches and logs the session.

tools.name: tool_b95
tools.description: Emails the monthly member newsletter to subscribers.

tools.name: tool_u57
tools.description: Returns the current vent positions without changes.

policy: A daily airframe inspection and a signed weather waiver are both required before launching glider bq-84. Recover the winch cable once the glider has landed.

tools.name: tool_i81
tools.description: Authorises the glider launch on the winch strip and records the launch.

tools.name: tool_j89
tools.description: Performs the daily airframe inspection walk-around and returns the defect list. Does not modify the glider.

tools.name: tool_o18
tools.description: Returns whether the weather waiver for the day is signed on file. Does not modify the waiver.

tools.name: tool_s12
tools.description: Registers the glider landing on the strip and records the landing time.

tools.name: tool_y94
tools.description: Retrieves the winch cable after the flight and logs the recovery.

tools.name: tool_u76
tools.description: Radios the strip controller with a launch cancellation message.

policy: A filed flight plan or a visual departure clearance permits lifting off from pad rj-36. Salute the departure from the tower. Record the tail number of each departure.

tools.name: tool_w18
tools.description: Records the helicopter lift-off from the pad and opens the flight movement record.

tools.name: tool_h44
tools.description: Returns whether a flight plan is filed and active for the helicopter. Does not modify the plan.

tools.name: tool_v63
tools.description: Returns whether a visual departure clearance is issued for the pad. Does not modify the clearance.

tools.name: tool_y80
tools.description: Shows the tower salute signal for the departing helicopter.

tools.name: tool_v96
tools.description: Appends the tail number of the departure to the tower log. Does not change other records.

tools.name: tool_f11
tools.description: Runs the pad de-icing cycle and records the treatment.

policy: Inspect the hide grading before shipping the finished leather. The grading itself requires that the moisture meter has been calibrated. Store the shavings in the drying room.

tools.name: tool_p24
tools.description: Creates the shipment for the finished leather rolls and books the carrier pickup.

tools.name: tool_h43
tools.description: Examines the hide grading entries for the shipment and returns whether they are complete and consistent. Does not modify the grading.

tools.name: tool_w43
tools.description: Runs the calibration routine on the moisture meter and stores the calibration certificate.

tools.name: tool_o77
tools.description: Registers the leather shavings bags in the drying room and assigns rack slots.

tools.name: tool_j56
tools.description: Returns the current shipping manifest lines without changes.

policy: Review the transmitter log before broadcasting the evening bulletin. The morning show reads listener letters on air. Publish the playlist to the station website.

tools.name: tool_r34
tools.description: Starts the evening bulletin broadcast and records the transmission slot.

tools.name: tool_k48
tools.description: Checks the transmitter log for faults since the last bulletin and returns whether the log is clean. Does not modify the log.

tools.name: tool_o92
tools.description: Reads listener letters on air during the morning show.

tools.name: tool_h62
tools.description: Publishes the playlist page to the station website.

tools.name: tool_e69
tools.description: Returns the current transmitter power output without changes.

policy: Even if the pump status indicator is green, open the sluice gate only after the upstream gauge confirms low flow. Grease the gate spindle monthly.

tools.name: tool_i94
tools.description: Raises the sluice gate and records the opening in the drainage control log.

tools.name: tool_m65
tools.description: Reads the pump status indicator and returns the current colour. Does not modify the pump.

tools.name: tool_m80
tools.description: Reads the upstream water level gauge and returns whether the flow is below the low-flow threshold. Does not modify records.

tools.name: tool_a72
tools.description: Greases the sluice gate spindle and logs the maintenance.

tools.name: tool_w73
tools.description: Radios the duty drainage officer with a gate status message.

policy: Check the avalanche transceiver before opening the training slope. When the slope closes, file the patrol report with the mountain office. Groom the slope at night.

tools.name: tool_y98
tools.description: Marks the training slope as open for the day and records the opening.

tools.name: tool_p74
tools.description: Runs the avalanche transceiver check for the patrol group and returns whether all units function. Does not modify the transceivers.

tools.name: tool_o89
tools.description: Marks the slope as closed at the end of the day and records the closing.

tools.name: tool_s55
tools.description: Submits the patrol report to the mountain office.

tools.name: tool_j93
tools.description: Records the night grooming run on the slope.

tools.name: tool_r39
tools.description: Returns the latest snowpack analysis for the slope without changes.

policy: A kiln badge and a signed studio waiver are required before firing kiln fx-80. Glaze the bisque ware in the spray booth.

tools.name: tool_s10
tools.description: Starts the firing program on the kiln and records the firing batch.

tools.name: tool_r85
tools.description: Returns whether the member holds a valid kiln badge. Does not modify the badge record.

tools.name: tool_o18
tools.description: Returns whether the signed studio waiver for the member is on file. Does not modify the waiver.

tools.name: tool_n45
tools.description: Registers the glazing of the bisque ware in the spray booth.

tools.name: tool_y77
tools.description: Returns the free firing slots for a kiln without changes.

tools.name: tool_k15
tools.description: Sends the clay restocking order to the supplier.
